message: 魔性の女

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, hey, Azel-chan. Wanna play cards together after this?」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Euu~~. What am I supposed to do until Nana-chan finishes~\s06」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do your homework.」
This sensation is the same as back then.......

name: Synn
message: 「To the Student Council room, hurry...... Let's gather with everyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could that be......」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...... They've made their move sooner than expected.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden? We haven't even started talking about the Holy Night Festival yet......」

name: Synn
message: 「Something similar has happened a few times before.」

name: Misa
message: 「So, what happened?」

name: Synn
message: 「I always felt a strange presence.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what they call a sex sense, right!!」

name: Misa
message: 「You mean sixth sense!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Every single time after I felt that presence, a Demon appeared.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think I was sensing some kind of power--probably magic or something like that......」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That means......」

name: Synn
message: 「And this time...... it feels like something intentionally set up.」

name: Synn
message: 「It was the same when I met Soltia. Like being drawn in by something--」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure someone is calling out to me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How do you know something like that......?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's...」
I met the eyes of Ria-senpai, who was gazing at me anxiously.
And then, I spoke with my eyes.
It's okay, Senpai.
Because you gave me courage, Ria-senpai.
I'm not scared anymore.
Because you stayed by my side even after finding out I'm the Demon Lord.
That's why I can keep moving forward.
As long as I'm with you, Ria-senpai.

name: Synn
message: 「It's probably because I'm the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though it's still this early, there's nobody around...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch... They went out of their way to put up a Null Barrier.」

name: Synn
message: 「A Void Barrier...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, it's a cheap trick that hides things by exploiting the preconception that nothing could possibly exist there.」

name: Synn
message: 「So anyone who already knows it exists can see it, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. The power of belief solidifies a thing's existence. If you don't know about it, though, its presence fades until it disappears.」

name: Synn
message: 「So by doing this, they can stay inside the academy without anyone noticing...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Indeed. However, its existence was not made known back then. Therefore, there was no way it could be seen.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I see... It seems Bylous was sending you signals like this in order to reveal its existence.」

name: Synn
message: 「So this time, you're the one who called me.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You were drawn here in reaction to the magic power, weren't you? Because you are the Demon Lord, Synn Sakura!」

name: Synn
message: 「Soltia!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「What happened to the rest of your friends? Do you really think you can stand against me all by yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm more than enough to handle this on my own.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Do you truly believe you can win without even using the Demon Lord's power...?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's probably one of the Seven Demon Generals. I think either Soltia or Bylous is calling me.」

name: Synn
message: 「The location is... um... around the plaza at the foot of Finis Tower...」

name: Misa
message: 「So they went out of their way to throw down the gauntlet, huh? They've got some nerve.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bring it on, I say.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never back down from a fight, right!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, everyone!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Like I said before, those two are on a whole different level. So... so it's not that simple...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you saying that even if all of the Crusaders banded together, we still couldn't win?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You mean there's a chance we'd lose even if we combined all our Crusader powers!?」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't know... I just don't know...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai is right.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun!! The power we've built up all this time isn't that weak, is it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I mean. The fact that they went out of their way to summon us means they're lying in wait.」

name: Misa
message: 「And what's wrong with that.」

name: Synn
message: 「It means they might have set a trap to put us at a disadvantage.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see...!」

name: Ria
message: 「They're too unpredictable to let our guard down... so I think we should face them under as fair conditions as possible.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then that means we shouldn't take their bait, right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, we can't just leave them alone, can we? There's no telling what they might do.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that's true, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What should we do, Senpai-san...」

name: Ria
message: 「We can't leave them alone... yet we have no chance of winning... I can't put everyone in any more danger...!」

name: Ria
message: 「What should... what should I do...? I don't know... I don't know what to do...」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine, Senpai. It's not like our chances are zero.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you going to do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you all trust me?」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Of course...... right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why even ask now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is there really any need to go out of your way to say that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...... you have a good plan, don't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Ria
message: 「......Then, I...... we believe in you, Synn-kun.」
At Ria-senpai's words, everyone nodded in unison.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, everyone...... Alright, here's the plan.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going alone.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Me alone is enough.」
In response to my combat stance, Soltia readies her staff.
However, she shows no sign of making a move.
The same goes for me.

name: Soltia
message: 「You're quite clever, aren't you.」

name: Soltia
message: 「That I can't lay a hand on you...... You noticed, didn't you. What Bylous ordered me to do.」

name: Soltia
message: 「And so you took advantage of that pretext to show up all by yourself.」

name: Synn
message: 「At the very least, as long as it doesn't become self-defense, it shouldn't come to a fight.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Naturally. I can't just let myself be taken down without resisting.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Heehee...... So, do you intend to bring this to a negotiation?」

name: Synn
message: 「If possible, that's what I'm hoping to do.」

name: Soltia
message: 「The answer is no. There was never any room for discussion to begin with.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Because there's nothing else that can be done. Fighting is the only option left to stop me.」

name: Synn
message: 「But since Bylous is holding you back, you shouldn't be able to fight me!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Are you suggesting I cower in Bylous's shadow...?」
Magical power overflows from Soltia's body.

name: Soltia
message: 「I would never cower before the likes of a mere demon!!」

name: Synn
message: 「--That's what she says, anyway, though the info that she can't lay a hand on me isn't 100% reliable.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then that makes it even more dangerous!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I figure we'll just count ourselves lucky if she actually buys that I came alone.」

name: Misa
message: 「A plan like that... There's no way you can pull it off all by yourself!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Five minutes.」

name: Synn
message: 「About five minutes. That's the limit for how long I can fully maintain the Demon Lord's power.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Demon Lord's power...」

name: Synn
message: 「I doubt she'll fall for any cheap tricks from me, so clashing head-on is pretty much inevitable.」

name: Synn
message: 「So I'll draw her in and wear her down as much as I can. Once she's exhausted, she's bound to get careless and leave an opening.」

name: Synn
message: 「Winning is a tall order. Still, I figured I could at least manage that much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okay, but what happens after that...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since she's a demon, the light attribute-Ria-senpai's power--should be her weakness.」

name: Ria
message: 「My power... You mean uniting everyone's strength into a single point in unison, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right when she's completely worn out, we hit her with a massive blast.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a really dangerous gamble...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, you're the only one... who can pull that off, aren't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「What is with that!!」

name: Misa
message: 「When you put it like that... we don't really have any choice but to go along with it...」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though we barely understand anything about the Demon Lord yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「About the Demon Lord... once this is over, I'll tell you everything properly. Everyone, trust me... please!」

name: Misa
message: 「'Trust me,' he says... What is his deal? He's just trying to act cool...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm still worried. With Synn all by himself...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I never knew waiting could be so painful... Aaah, I'm so worried~~\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai... aren't you worried at all, Senpai?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Once something happens, it'll be too late!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If anything were to happen to Synn, I...」

name: Ria
message: 「Just a little longer... so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sure Synn-kun trusts us...」

name: Ria
message: 「So, I'll trust Synn-kun too...!!」
Unable to hold out any longer, Soltia's magic burst right before his eyes.
Pain so intense it threatened to knock him unconscious assaulted him.
Soltia had left nothing to chance.
She had laid traps all over the area to inhibit the Demon Lord's awakening.
With his full power sealed away, the tide of battle was visibly against him.
Yet, by believing in those backing him up, he was able to stand back up time and time again.
However--
Taking direct hits back-to-back was bad, no matter what.
First, his body screamed in agony, unable to withstand the fierce onslaught.
He had been battered so badly he could no longer even form words.
The moment he reached his limit was drawing near.

name: Soltia
message: 「Farewell.」
Yet, facing the unleashed power, he did not close his eyes in fear.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew, made it in time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just in the nick of time~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, how pathetic can you get?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Haha...\s02」

name: Soltia
message: 「So you've finally shown yourself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah... hah... Did I manage to hold out for five minutes...?」

name: Ria
message: 「You held out for six.」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone, let's go!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It landed...!!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...!?」

name: Misa
message: 「It didn't work at all!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How can she be so tough...」

name: Ria
message: 「No... the Spirit Power was repelled--it was neutralized...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They canceled each other out!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Light can only be neutralized by light... And light is the power of spirits. A power only angels can wield...」

name: Ria
message: 「And yet... there's a demon wielding the power of light...」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me, Soltia is...」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you saying... that you're an angel?」

name: Soltia
message: 「There's no need to tell you. Because--」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「You're all going to disappear right here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-What are we supposed to do... on our own...」

name: Misa
message: 「Pull yourselves together!! We haven't lost yet. I'll handle this--」

name: Ria
message: 「No, Misa-chan!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Please... r-run...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Run away? No, we couldn't...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We could never do something like that!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「You've wandered into my domain. Running away was never an option for you in the first place.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is this the end for us...?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Vanish in despair!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sisteeeer!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop it...」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll protect Senpai... I'll...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Heehee, what can you possibly do in that state--」

name: Soltia
message: 「Wha...!? Don't tell me, the Demon Lord's power is...!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「I was supposed to have suppressed its awakening, so how...!!」

name: Female Voice
message: 「--You let your guard down, Soltia.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You forced your way into my domain...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you truly believe a fake like this... can make you an angel?」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You're...!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「The Nive Clan-so you really were here!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you really have time to be chattering away?!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Tch!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey!! Don't run!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Stooooop!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Haah... haah... You're the ones who are going to stop...」

name: Misa
message: 「Helena... san...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Haah... haah... It seems I made it just in time.\s10」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sis... why...」

name: Helena
message: 「What's with that? I rushed over as fast as I could because you were in a pinch.」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-Thank you\s01 But, that's not what I meant...」

name: Ria
message: 「Why is Melilot-san here...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is everyone unharmed?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... ughh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Regrettably, it appears not everyone is unharmed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Waaaaah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Presideeeent!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, hang in there, Sakura-kun!!」
Ria-senpai hoists my body onto her back.

name: Ria
message: 「Somewhere he can rest... To the infirmary!」

name: Helena
message: 「No, let's go to the chairwoman's office. There's a comfortable bed in there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why there...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, ah!! Senpaiii, please waaaait!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Anyway, I'm just glad everyone is safe.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry... Getting into a mess like this without even letting you know, Helena-san.」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, don't talk right now. You need to get plenty of rest.」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, after what happened today... To think that Melilot-san is... 」

name: Misa
message: 「Soltia called her something like the Nive Clan, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please forget about that already.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The librarian just made a blatantly disgusted face.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe she doesn't really want to be called that?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Eekeeeeeeeeee!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san... you were a demon all along.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, just as you've guessed.」

name: Synn
message: 「That power that drove back Soltia couldn't have been anything ordinary.」

name: Ria
message: 「In fact, it rivals... no, surpasses even the Seven Demon Generals.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The Seven Demon Generals...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sigh... That custom is still around? How absurd.」

name: Helena
message: 「Look who's talking, Melilot. Even though you're called one yourself.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, ehhhh!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That title was just slapped onto me by some random person as they pleased. I have no recollection of ever inheriting such a name.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-no way... The librarian of our academy's library is...」

name: Misa
message: 「One of the Seven Demon Generals...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They're surprisingly close to home, aren't they~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's an angel here too, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fweh!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've heard a great deal about everything from Helena.」

name: Melilot
message: 「From my analysis, it's obvious that Soltia and Bylous have joined forces and are plotting something by taking advantage of Re-Crea.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Until now, Soltia and Pasta have been forming a magic circle boasting a massive area within the academy in order to amplify Re-Crea's energy.」

name: Melilot
message: 「By doing so, they likely intended to make the chaos even greater.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So you knew that much, yet you lay low all this time?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was letting them roam free until their objective became clear.」

name: Ria
message: 「Why would you let such dangerous people just roam free!!」

name: Ria
message: 「What would you have done... if something terrible had happened......」

name: Melilot
message: 「The answer is simple. Because I could have stopped those two at any time.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia created a barrier and trapped you all inside to corner you for interfering with the magic circle's formation.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I intervened and destroyed it. Stopping riffraff of their caliber is effortless.」

name: Melilot
message: 「What I want to know is what they intend to do by taking advantage of Re-Crea, and what they are capable of doing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In order to uncover their true motives, by my calculations, there was no disadvantage to letting the two of them roam free.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then the reason we ended up in danger was because we stuck our noses in where we shouldn't have......」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you saying our uncalculated actions meant we brought it on ourselves?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't think very highly of such self-deprecating thoughts.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hold on, Melilot. You're being immature.」

name: Melilot
message: 「......You're right. After all, I couldn't possibly let you lose your futures as well.」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot......」

name: Melilot
message: 「For things to have turned out like this...... I'm truly sorry.」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, please......」

name: Synn
message: 「......I understand. Just how seriously you...... saved us, Melilot-san......」

name: Synn
message: 「That power isn't something you could just casually draw out......」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way we can just leave enemies like that alone......」

name: Melilot
message: 「I agree. Now that we've revealed our true identities as well, I have no intention of staying silent like this.」

name: Ria
message: 「What are you planning to do?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if we want to make a move, there is still too much uncertain information. In order to clarify it, we will need the Crusaders' support.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ours...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. And the Demon Lord's power.」

name: Synn
message: 「The Demon Lord's...」

name: Ria
message: 「H-How do you know about that, Big Sis...!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Ria-senpai...」

name: Helena
message: 「I just kind of had a hunch, is all... Judging by Ria's reaction, though, it looks like I hit the bullseye.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm sorry, Synn-kun.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's already out in the open with everyone else anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Just as Helena-san says, I am the Demon Lord. I inherited that title from my father.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see... Thank you for telling me honestly.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ria. Aren't you glad the Demon Lord turned out to be Synn-chan?」

name: Helena
message: 「After all, Synn-chan doesn't seem capable of abusing the Demon Lord's power.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please say I wouldn't, not that I couldn't.\s02」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee. I'm just happy, you know. Being able to meet someone I've admired.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, I couldn't hold a candle to Soltia...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, of course. You lack the self-awareness of being the Demon Lord, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...! Because without that self-awareness, the Demon Lord's power isn't supposed to be able to awaken, right...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Precisely. That is why the power you've used up until now is merely a stopgap measure.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm still in my growing phase, you know. Just like this!!」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Self-awareness isn't a matter of willpower. It's something much simpler and more natural.」

name: Helena
message: 「And to get that across to you, I asked Melilot for a little help.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. Right now, you are merely borrowing the power of your guardian angel. However, haven't you forgotten something?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The Demon Lord is the king of the Demons. By nature, you are capable of wielding an equal... no, an even greater energy without relying on your guardian angel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The power known as magic.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Magic is the true essence of the Demon Lord's power. You simply do not know the art of wielding it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is why, even when you draw out your latent demonic power, you are unable to demonstrate your true potential.」

name: Melilot
message: 「A Demon capable of handling Spirit Power is an anomaly. Ordinarily, the two repel one another and disrupt internal harmony.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yet your very existence made it possible. Demonic power permitted you, and Spirit Power accepted you.」

name: Ria
message: 「The demonic power of Demons, and the Spirit Power of angels... A special existence where those two can become one. That is--」

name: Melilot
message: 「The Demon Lord.」

name: Ria
message: 「No, that's not it. I'm sure it's because it's Synn-kun... Because it's Synn-kun, it was possible.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why do you think so?」

name: Ria
message: 「All this time I've spent with Synn-kun, he's treated both angels and Demons without discrimination.」

name: Ria
message: 「So before I knew it... I started wishing that Synn-kun was the Demon Lord.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun was a little different from the Demon Lord I had heard about from Mother. Even so, I--」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm truly glad that Synn-kun is the Demon Lord. Nothing could ever make me happier than this.」

name: Helena
message: 「See? Didn't I tell you it was a good thing?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. I will teach you the art of magic and draw out your fullest power as the Demon Lord.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, it will be grueling training. No one else can bear that pain--you alone will have to endure it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「As for myself, I have no wish to subject you students to anything further that would threaten your futures.」

name: Synn
message: 「But if I can protect everyone...!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will repeat myself. You will undergo grueling instruction. With half-baked resolve, you will end up destroying yourself.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, will you choose the path of living as a Demon Lord--different from the human you have lived as up until now?」
Ria-senpai believes in me.
And she supports me without harboring a single doubt that I'm the Demon Lord.
What kind of Demon Lord would I be if I didn't answer that!!

name: Synn
message: 「I'll become my own kind of Demon Lord. I'll do it... Please let me do it!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Understood. We shall begin as soon as your physical condition recovers. Please rest well today.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is all. Good work today.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A rapid-fire Q&A?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. There is no need to gauge the other person's reaction every single time.」

name: Melilot
message: 「More importantly, I had already calculated that the probability of Sakura-kun refusing was 0%.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-Then you didn't have to go out of your way to explain... wait, ah.」
Come to think of it, when she taught me how to borrow books at the library, there was a similar kind of pressing confirmation like just now.

name: Melilot
message: 「I am impressed that you did not chicken out. As expected of the Student Council President.」

name: Ria
message: 「But then why didn't you cooperate with us until just now! Even you were in on it, Big Sis!」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if you say that... right, Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. After all, I never dreamed that the Demon Lord was right here so close by.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds so fake...」

name: Ria
message: 「I bet you were having fun teasing us. How rude.」

name: Helena
message: 「You're wrong. It'd be uncool if I guessed wrong about him being the Demon Lord, wouldn't it? A commander must never show weakness!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the reason.\s02」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let me make this clear, my cooperation is strictly for the purpose of raising the odds.」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, Melilot, you always have to say such cold things~」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, please excuse me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Can we... really be of help to you, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if it's a mere 1%, that isn't 0%」

name: Melilot
message: 「The potential is hidden within. It's surely worth trying.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I call that 1% hope.」
